title: KNBS county livestock population, Kenya (2021)
source: KNBS — National Agriculture Production Report 2023–2024 (NAPR 2024), Annexes 15 (cattle/sheep/goats) + 18 (donkeys/camels)
citation: KNBS 2024. National Agriculture Production Report: 2023-2024. Nairobi, Kenya.
license: KNBS — public official statistics; cite KNBS.
method: Dual-engine deterministic extraction (_sources/parse_napr_livestock.py): pdfplumber extract_tables vs PyMuPDF word-clustering, cell-by-cell; values parsed by code, never LLM-read. Cattle = dairy+beef, Sheep = wool+hair, Goats = dairy+meat (sub-types summed). Head counts.
validation: Dual-engine cell agreement: cattle/sheep/goats 2021 (p129) 255/257 = 99%; donkeys/camels 2021 (p132) 72/72 = 100%. Semantically sanity-checked: Turkana cattle 2.5M / sheep 6.6M / goats 7.0M; Marsabit camels 283k; Nakuru (highland) cattle-heavy, ~0 camels — matches the ASAL-vs-highland pattern.
grain: one row per species × county × year
coverage: 5 species, year 2021, 46 counties (Nairobi has negligible livestock).
known_gaps: 2022 + 2023 cattle/sheep/goats annexes (pp.130-131) quarantined: one page (p131, 2023) scored only 71% dual-engine agreement (engine misalignment on dashes/blanks) - not served until resolved. Livestock is a stock, so the 2021 snapshot is representative.
Poultry (Annex 24-26) + livestock products (Annex 27) available in the same report - not yet extracted.
used_by: notebook.qmd Key Facts — 'What does my county produce?' Livestock toggle (Table / Bars / Treemap views)
